tools.description: Open a RenderDoc capture file (.rdc) for analysis. Returns the graphics API type and total event/draw counts. Closes any previously opened capture.

path.description: Absolute path to the .rdc capture file

tools.name: open_capture

tools.description: List all draw calls and actions in the currently opened capture.
tools.name: list_events

tools.description: Navigate to a specific event by its event ID.
tools.name: goto_event

tools.description: List draw calls with vertex/index counts, instance counts, and flags.
tools.name: list_draws

tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific draw call.

eventId.description: Event ID of the draw call

tools.name: get_draw_info

tools.description: Get metadata about the currently opened capture file including API, GPU, resolution, total event/draw counts, and driver info.
tools.name: get_capture_info

tools.description: Get performance statistics: per-pass breakdown, top draws by triangle count, largest resources.
tools.name: get_stats

tools.description: Get debug/validation messages from the capture.
tools.name: get_log

tools.description: List all GPU resources (textures, buffers, shaders, etc.) in the capture with type and size info

type.description: Filter by resource type keyword (e.g. Texture, Buffer, Shader)

tools.name: list_resources

tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific GPU resource by its ID
tools.name: get_resource_info

tools.description: List all render passes in the capture (marker regions containing draw or dispatch calls)
tools.name: list_passes

tools.description: Get details about a specific render pass including its draw calls

eventId.description: Event ID of the pass marker

tools.name: get_pass_info

tools.description: Get shader disassembly or reflection data at an event for a given stage
tools.name: get_shader

tools.description: List all unique shaders used in the capture with their stages and usage count
tools.name: list_shaders

tools.description: Search shader disassembly text across all shaders for a pattern

pattern.description: Text pattern to search for (case-insensitive substring)

tools.name: search_shaders

tools.description: Get the graphics pipeline state at the current or specified event. Returns bound shaders, render targets, viewports, and pipeline configuration.

eventId.description: Event ID to inspect (uses current if omitted)

tools.name: get_pipeline_state

tools.description: Get descriptor/resource bindings for all shader stages at the current or specified event. Shows constant buffers, textures, UAVs, and samplers from shader reflection.
tools.name: get_bindings

tools.description: Export the current event's render target as a PNG file. The file is saved to an auto-generated path in the capture's directory. Call goto_event first to select which event to export.
tools.name: export_render_target

tools.description: Export a texture resource as a PNG image by resource ID.
tools.name: export_texture

tools.description: Export buffer data to a binary file.
tools.name: export_buffer

tools.description: Launch an application with RenderDoc injected, capture a frame after a delay, and automatically open it for analysis. Returns capture info (API, total event/draw counts) and the .rdc file path.

cmdLine.description: Command line arguments for the target

delayFrames.description: Number of frames to wait before capturing. Default: 100

exePath.description: Absolute path to the target executable

outputPath.description: Path for the .rdc file. Default: auto-generated in temp directory

workingDir.description: Working directory for the target. Defaults to exePath's parent directory

tools.name: capture_frame

tools.description: Query the modification history of a pixel up to the current or specified event. Returns which draws wrote to the pixel, shader output values (float/uint/int), post-blend values, depth, and pass/fail status. Note: history is bounded by the specified eventId.

eventId.description: Event ID to query up to (default: current event)

tools.name: pixel_history

tools.description: Read the color value of a single pixel at the current or specified event. Returns float, uint, and int representations.
tools.name: pick_pixel

tools.description: Debug the pixel/fragment shader at a specific pixel. Returns shader inputs, outputs, and optionally a full step-by-step execution trace. Variables preserve their original types (float/uint/int) and struct members.
tools.name: debug_pixel

tools.description: Debug the vertex shader for a specific vertex. Returns shader inputs, outputs, and optionally a full execution trace.

index.description: Raw index buffer value for indexed draws

tools.name: debug_vertex

tools.description: Debug a compute shader thread at a specific workgroup and thread coordinate. Returns shader inputs, outputs, and optionally a full execution trace.
tools.name: debug_thread

tools.description: Get min/max pixel values and optionally a 256-bucket histogram for a texture. Returns typed values (float/uint/int). Useful for detecting NaN values, all-black textures, or unexpected value ranges.

eventId.description: Event ID for texture state (default: current)

tools.name: get_texture_stats

tools.description: List shader compilation encodings supported by the current capture. Call this before shader_build to determine valid encoding values.
tools.name: shader_encodings

tools.description: Compile shader source code. Returns a shaderId for use with shader_replace. Encoding must be one of the values from shader_encodings.
tools.name: shader_build

tools.description: Replace a shader at the given event/stage with a previously built shader. Affects ALL draws using the same shader globally.
tools.name: shader_replace

tools.description: Restore a single shader to its original version.
tools.name: shader_restore

tools.description: Restore all replaced shaders and free all built shader resources.
tools.name: shader_restore_all

tools.description: Export post-transform vertex data from a draw call as OBJ or JSON. Decodes vertex positions and generates triangle faces from topology.

outputPath.description: File path to write (optional, returns inline if omitted)

tools.name: export_mesh

tools.description: Export complete draw call state: pipeline, shaders, render targets, and depth. Creates a directory with manifest.json indexing all exported files.
tools.name: export_snapshot

tools.description: Get the usage history of a resource across all events. Shows which events read, write, or bind the resource.
tools.name: get_resource_usage

tools.description: Assert that a pixel at (x,y) matches expected RGBA values within tolerance. Returns pass/fail with actual vs expected values.
tools.name: assert_pixel

tools.description: Assert that a pipeline state field matches an expected value. Path uses dot notation matching the pipeline JSON output (e.g. vertexShader.entryPoint).
tools.name: assert_state

tools.description: Compare two PNG images pixel-by-pixel. Returns pass/fail with diff statistics. Optionally writes a diff visualization PNG.

diffOutputPath.description: Path to write diff visualization PNG

tools.name: assert_image

tools.description: Assert that a count of resources/events/draws matches expected value. Uses accurate counts bypassing default list limits.
tools.name: assert_count

tools.description: Assert that no debug/validation messages exist at or above the specified severity. Returns pass/fail with any matching messages.

minSeverity.description: Minimum severity to fail on (default: high)

tools.name: assert_clean

tools.description: Open two RenderDoc captures for side-by-side diffing. Returns capture info for both captures.
tools.name: diff_open

tools.description: Close the current diff session and release both captures.
tools.name: diff_close

tools.description: Get a high-level summary diff between the two open captures. Returns per-category counts (draws, resources, passes) with deltas.
tools.name: diff_summary

tools.description: Diff draw calls between the two open captures. Returns aligned rows with added/deleted/modified/unchanged counts.
tools.name: diff_draws

tools.description: Diff resources (textures, buffers) between the two open captures. Returns aligned rows with status and type information.
tools.name: diff_resources

tools.description: Diff per-pass statistics between the two open captures. Returns pass rows with draw/triangle/dispatch deltas.
tools.name: diff_stats

tools.description: Diff pipeline state at a named marker between the two captures. Returns field-level differences for the matched draw.

marker.description: Marker path to locate the draw in both captures

tools.name: diff_pipeline

tools.description: Compare framebuffer output between the two captures at specific event IDs. Returns pixel-level diff statistics and optionally writes a diff image.

diffOutput.description: Path to write diff visualization PNG

eidA.description: Event ID in capture A (default: 0 = last)

eidB.description: Event ID in capture B (default: 0 = last)

tools.name: diff_framebuffer

tools.description: Query color and depth attachments for a render pass (format, dimensions, resource IDs)

eventId.description: Event ID within the pass (marker or draw)

tools.name: get_pass_attachments

tools.description: Return per-pass aggregated statistics: draw/dispatch counts, triangles, RT dimensions
tools.name: get_pass_statistics

tools.description: Build inter-pass resource dependency DAG showing which passes feed data to others
tools.name: get_pass_deps

tools.description: Detect render targets written but never consumed by visible output (optimization hints)
tools.name: find_unused_targets
